name: civicos-san-rafael
description: Access San Rafael city council meetings, decisions, budget data, and 311 issues. Research civic topics, prepare public comments, and track what your local government is doing.

tools.name: search_meeting_history
tools.description: Search past city council meetings and decisions on a topic

tools.name: get_upcoming_meetings
tools.description: Get upcoming city council meetings and agenda items

tools.name: find_similar_issues
tools.description: Find community issues related to a topic via 311/SeeClickFix

tools.name: search_regulatory_stack
tools.description: Search laws and regulations across local, state, and federal levels

tools.name: compose_public_comment
tools.description: Get context for writing a public comment on a civic agenda item

tools.name: city_pulse
tools.description: Get a snapshot of city activity (meetings, decisions, issues)

tools.name: search_budget
tools.description: Search city budget items and expenditures

tools.name: get_public_testimony
tools.description: Find past public testimony on a topic with video timestamps

tools.name: search_agenda_packets
tools.description: Search agenda packet documents (staff reports, attachments)

tools.name: get_voting_record
tools.description: Get voting history for council members

tools.name: get_decision_context
tools.description: Get full context around a specific council decision

tools.name: get_funding_flow
tools.description: Trace federal/state funding to local programs

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Get onboarding guidance based on user type (resident, staff, developer)

example_queries: What did the city council decide about housing last month?
When is the next city council meeting?
Are there potholes reported near my neighborhood?
What laws apply to accessory dwelling units in San Rafael?
Help me prepare a public comment about the downtown plan
What is the city's budget for parks and recreation?
What have residents said about traffic safety?
How did council members vote on the homeless services item?
